results: Different devices with renamed copies share the same content index, phrase highlight and public note; ownership controls stay private
A second reader can add literal HTML text safely; each author can edit only their own note and changes reach other readers
TR layout preserves public phrase highlights; delayed notes for a previous word never replace the selected word
Deletion removes only the owned note; highlight remains while another note exists and clears after the final note is deleted
Offline submit is explicitly unshared; the local draft survives reload without fabricating notes or highlights
No uncaught JavaScript errors; notes fit 320px screens
